{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Originator** – Who proposed the idea.
- **Date Proposed** – When the idea was submitted.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, Reviewed, In Progress, On Hold, Implemented, Archived).
- **Priority** – Suggested priority level (Low, Medium, High, Critical).
- **Notes** – Additional comments, feedback, or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this document.
2. Scroll to the bottom.
3. Add a new entry following the structure above.
4. Save the document.

## Review Process
- **Weekly Review** – Team leads review all new ideas every Friday.
- **Decision Criteria** – Feasibility, impact, resource availability, alignment with goals.
- **Action Items** – Assign owners and set deadlines.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Chatbot
Description: Develop an AI chatbot to handle customer inquiries 24/7.
Originator: Jane Doe
Date Proposed: 2024-10-09
Status: New
Priority: High
Notes: Requires integration with CRM.
```

Feel free to adapt this template to fit your team's workflow.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.md"}

{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Originator** – Who proposed the idea.
- **Date Proposed** – When the idea was submitted.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, Reviewed, In Progress, On Hold, Implemented, Archived).
- **Priority** – Suggested priority level (Low, Medium, High, Critical).
- **Notes** – Additional comments, feedback, or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this document.
2. Scroll to the bottom.
3. Add a new entry following the structure above.
4. Save the document.

## Review Process
- **Weekly Review** – Team leads review all new ideas every Friday.
- **Decision Criteria** – Feasibility, impact, resource availability, alignment with goals.
- **Action Items** – Assign owners and set deadlines.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Chatbot
Description: Develop an AI chatbot to handle customer inquiries 24/7.
Originator: Jane Doe
Date Proposed: 2024-10-09
Status: New
Priority: High
Notes: Requires integration with CRM.
```

Feel free to adapt this template to fit your team's workflow.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.md"}
